reviews.title: Outstanding Microphone Set for Streamers!
reviews.comment:
I recently upgraded to the Sennheiser Professional Profile USB Microphone Streaming Set with Boom Arm, and it has exceeded all my expectations. The build quality is solid and durable, giving me confidence that this microphone set will last for a long time. The materials used are top-notch, and it feels very sturdy.
The installation process was incredibly easy and straightforward. I had everything set up and ready to go in no time. The boom arm is a fantastic addition, providing excellent flexibility and positioning options for my streaming setup.
One of the standout features is the great cord management. The design allows for neat and tidy cable routing, which helps keep my workspace organized and clutter-free. This is a huge plus for anyone who values a clean and professional-looking setup.
Overall, the Sennheiser Professional Profile USB Microphone Streaming Set with Boom Arm is a fantastic investment for streamers and content creators. It offers exceptional sound quality, durability, and ease of use. Five stars all the way!
reviews.author: Jonathan

reviews.title: Awesone mic ser you may not need to upgrade
reviews.comment:
This microphone works great and the boom arm is a must have for many application. The boom arm is made extremely well and far surpasses any of the cheap secondary arms out there for the price difference between this package and the one without it.
If you want good quality, ease of use (plug it in and start using it, no software necessary). I had to use a USB-C to USB-A converter but that did not affect its functionality at all. Having all the necessary controls on the mic without having to go into any mic settings on the pc is also extremely friendly to use with no real sound transfer when using them. The mute button doesnt cause any noticeable clicks thru the mic either.
I ise this for several purposes but mostly for voice chat while gaming and proper positioning doesnt pick up keyboard clicks with a quieter mechanical keyboard.
On a side note it also pairs nicely with other specialized microphone software for much more control of its sound quality or style if you need that, such ss the SteelseriesGG. Doesnt quite have the sound quality of a Shure but the price difference for me doesnt justify paying so much more for the Shure. A true audiophile may think differently but for a good quality, feature rich mic with a boom arm that is easily worth $100 in itself, this is a great microphone set.
It can easily do everything you need for quality gaming and even podcasting for those starting out and not wanting to break the bank on a high end Shure. I’d look into a Shure later if your podcasting starts to make you money to justify it but until that point you may just live this Sennheiser for a long time, and it will certainly last you for as long as you want it to.
reviews.author: Branden

reviews.title: My new favorite brand of mic
reviews.comment: Mic is spectacularly clear. Super easy to set up/connectivity. Just plug in the usb-c to a pc and you're pretty much ready to use the mic instantly. The boom arm it came with is also great quality. Mostly all metal and easy to adjust, yet still holds in place nice and firm in any direction. Great price for a great mic. Also has multiple controls for fine tuning volume and other applications.
reviews.author: Joseph

reviews.title: I've been using Sennheiser mics professionally for years, this one does NOT disapoint!
reviews.comment: As an audio engineer for 20+ years in the heyday of rock (80s-90s) I used Sennheiser in both the studio and live.  They have a reputation as being 'delicate', but I found with reasonable care, they did well for years on the road.  This mic was purchased for our podcast work and for the dozens of Zoom meetings I have each month.  It set up fast, worked immediately, and has continued to function flawlessly now for months.  It's a bit sensitive to 'body noise' so an isolation mount is really required (get on the stick here Sennheiser, I had to adapt an aftermarket mount.  You should have one available!!) and I used the AT2020 mount from Youshares, which works well.  Careful the mount you choose does not obstruct the knobs on the front of the mic, but otherwise any mount that accepts a 1.5" mic will work.  Great mic for voice, and the arm is pretty nifty too!
reviews.author: Terri E.
